name: context-canvas-codex
description: Bounded task maps plus policy-sanitized historical tool snapshots for Codex App and CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Recover task state and archive historical tool snapshots.
interface.longDescription: Keeps bounded task facts and hash-bound evidence pointers separate from a local PostToolUse snapshot store with explicit textual-redaction and opaque-media policies. Snapshots are compressed, content-addressed, deduplicated, excluded from semantic search, time-limited unless pinned, and exportable through an explicit CLI operation.
defaultPrompt: Create a safe checkpoint for this long-running task.
Restore this task's active blockers after compaction.
Search this task's Context Canvas and prepare a closeout.
List historical tool snapshots and export one policy-sanitized payload.
